For every graph $G$ with a nonempty edge set, Bača et al. [5] established the bounds

 $\operatorname{tes}(G)\geq\max\left\{\left\lceil\frac{{|E(G)|}+2}{3}\right\rceil,\left\lceil\frac{\Delta(G)+1}{2}\right\rceil\right\},$
